title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Justice, and the All China Lawyers Association on Issuing the Opinions on Further Promoting Lawyers' Participation in the Enforcement Work of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court  Ministry of Justice  All China Lawyers Association

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Deeply Promoting Lawyers' Participation in the Enforcement Work of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2019] No. 34

The High People's Courts, Departments (Bureaus) of Justice, and Lawyers Associations of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and the Bureau of Justice and Lawyers Association of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In order to earnestly implement the relevant requirements of the "Opinions on Strengthening Comprehensive Governance to Effectively Solve the Problem of Enforcement Difficulty from the Source" (Zhong Fa Wei Fa [2019] No. 1) of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Law-Based Governance, and to form a joint force to solve enforcement difficulties, the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Justice, and the All China Lawyers Association have studied and formulated the "Opinions on Deeply Promoting Lawyers' Participation in the Enforcement Work of People's Courts." These are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

December 25, 2019

Opinions on Deeply Promoting Lawyers' Participation in the Enforcement Work of People's Courts

In order to thoroughly implement the major decision-making and deployment of "effectively solving enforcement difficulties" and "ensuring that prevailing parties realize their rights and interests in a timely manner in accordance with the law" put forward by the Fourth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and in accordance with the requirements of the "Opinions on Strengthening Comprehensive Governance to Effectively Solve the Problem of Enforcement Difficulty from the Source" (Zhong Fa Wei Fa [2019] No. 1) of the Central Committee for Comprehensive Law-Based Governance that "all regions and departments actively introduce professional forces to participate in enforcement, establish and improve working mechanisms for the deep participation of professional institutions and personnel such as arbitration, notarization, lawyers, accounting, and auditing in enforcement, and form a social joint force to solve enforcement difficulties," and in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, these Opinions are formulated on deeply promoting lawyers' participation in the enforcement work of people's courts.

I. Deeply Understand the Significance of Lawyers' Participation in Enforcement Work

1. The enforcement work of people's courts is an important means of ensuring the comprehensive and accurate implementation of laws by relying on state coercive force, and is a key link in safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of the people and realizing social fairness and justice. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has attached great importance to the enforcement work of people's courts, designated solving enforcement difficulties as an important part of comprehensive law-based governance, made major decisions and arrangements, and required all regions and relevant departments to fully understand the important significance of enforcement work, strengthen the implementation of responsibilities, form a joint work force, and actively construct a grand framework for comprehensive governance and source governance of enforcement difficulties.

Lawyers, as socialist legal workers and an important part of the legal profession community, are important participants in the trial and enforcement activities of people's courts and play an important role in promoting comprehensive law-based governance and building a socialist country under the rule of law. Deeply promoting lawyers' participation in enforcement work helps to implement the people-centered development philosophy, practice the purpose of serving justice for the people, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of the parties in accordance with the law; helps to establish and improve a long-term mechanism for solving enforcement difficulties, enhance enforcement work capability, and maintain the high-level operation of enforcement work; and helps to gather forces from all sides, enhance the legal awareness, integrity awareness, and risk awareness of the whole society, and promote comprehensive law-based governance and the construction of a social credit system.

II. Give Full Play to the Important Role of Lawyers in Enforcement Work

2. Give full play to the promoting role of lawyers in the enforcement work of people's courts. In recent years, as the number of enforcement cases continues to increase and the level of professionalization of enforcement continues to improve, there is an urgent need for professional forces such as lawyers to participate deeply in enforcement, and to promote the timely and effective enforcement of effective legal documents by performing their functions and undertaking some auxiliary work. In particular, many parties have significant needs in terms of professional knowledge and searching for persons and property, and need lawyers to play an active role in the application of legal norms, the search for property clues, the assessment of enforcement risks, and the relief of legitimate rights and interests, and to meet the growing judicial needs of the people by providing high-quality and efficient legal services.

People's courts at all levels should further enhance their understanding of the importance of lawyers' participation in enforcement, combine it with actual work, actively explore and innovate various working mechanisms to protect lawyers' right to practice, improve the practice environment for lawyers, and promote lawyers' participation in enforcement, providing support and convenience for lawyers to perform their duties in accordance with the law and give full play to their advantages.

3. Give full play to the role of lawyers in promoting the resolution of conflicts and disputes. Enforcement work is highly confrontational and risky, and is very likely to cause conflicts and disputes. Full play should be given to the role of the agent lawyer as a bridge and link to promote communication and coordination between the parties and between the parties and the people's court. The agent lawyer should guide and assist the parties to correctly understand the judgment results of effective legal documents, and make them fully aware of the risks and consequences of refusing to perform legal obligations. If a party does not recognize the judgment result, it should guide the party to resolve it through the corresponding procedure in accordance with the law. If there is a possibility of settlement, settlement suggestions may be made to assist the client in reaching an enforcement settlement with the other party. When assisting the parties in drafting a settlement agreement, the lawyer should adhere to the requirements of diligence and professionalism to ensure that the elements are complete, the wording is standardized, and it is feasible. If a party fails to perform the settlement agreement, the agent lawyer may assist the client in applying to the people's court for resumption of enforcement in accordance with the law, or file a lawsuit with the people's court regarding the performance of the enforcement settlement agreement.

People's courts at all levels should establish and improve a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for enforcement cases, encourage the resolution of enforcement disputes through lawyer mediation and other means, explore and promote the establishment of "lawyer volunteer service posts" and "lawyer mediation studios," do a good job in the convergence of enforcement and mediation, and create conditions and convenience for lawyers to participate in conflict resolution as neutral third parties.

4. Give full play to the role of lawyers in property preservation. The agent lawyer should fully explain the litigation risks to the parties, clarify the importance of property preservation to the realization of their rights and interests, and guide the parties to apply to the people's court for property preservation in a timely manner. If preservation measures have been taken, remind the parties that they may apply to the people's court for renewal of preservation seven days before the expiration of the preservation period; if the circumstances for lifting preservation are met, remind the parties that they may apply for lifting preservation in a timely manner.

People's courts at all levels should increase the application of litigation preservation, simplify the preservation work process, promote the preservation insurance guarantee mechanism, and provide convenience for parties to apply for preservation. They should publicize the conditions, methods, and procedures for applying for preservation, promptly accept and take preservation measures for property preservation applications that meet the conditions, and inform the applicant or the agent lawyer of the content of the preservation ruling, the expiration date of the preservation period, and matters concerning the application for renewal of preservation, fully protecting the right to know, the right to object, and the right to appeal of the parties and their agent lawyers.

5. Give full play to the role of lawyers in enforcement investigation. The agent lawyer of the enforcement applicant may assist the enforcement applicant in providing the people's court with information on the property status or clues of the person subject to enforcement that is known to him, apply to the people's court for investigation, and if necessary, may apply to the people's court for issuing a reward announcement or entrusting an audit institution to conduct an audit. The agent lawyer of the person subject to enforcement shall inform the person subject to enforcement of the obligation to truthfully report property to the people's court, and explain the legal consequences of refusing to report, falsely reporting, or overdue reporting of property.

The people's court shall conduct enforcement investigations through the enforcement network inquiry and control system and other necessary means. It shall protect the lawyer's right to investigate and collect evidence in accordance with the law, further expand the methods and channels of enforcement investigation, and study and establish a relevant working mechanism for entrusting lawyers to investigate.

6. Give full play to the role of lawyers in property control and realization. The people's court shall promptly seize, attach, and freeze the property of the person subject to enforcement to the extent necessary to satisfy the obligation to be performed. After completing property control, it shall promptly notify the enforcement applicant or the agent lawyer in writing of the property control status. Before the expiration of the seizure, attachment, or freezing period, the agent lawyer may assist the enforcement applicant in applying to the people's court for an extension of the period to prevent consequences such as the transfer of property after the expiration of the period.

The people's court shall promptly realize the value of the controlled property, and strictly prohibit illegal appraisal, auction of property, and illegal satisfaction of debts with property in kind. During the process of the people's court determining the reference price for property disposal, the agent lawyer shall assist the parties in cooperating with the people's court to ascertain in accordance with the law the ownership, encumbrances, possession and use, overdue taxes and fees, quality defects, and other matters of the property to be realized. The people's court shall protect the agent lawyer's right to practice during the property realization process in accordance with the law, ensuring the openness, fairness, and impartiality of the property realization process.

After the enforcement funds are received, the people's court shall notify the enforcement applicant or the specially authorized agent lawyer to go through the collection procedures within the prescribed time limit, and strictly prohibit concealing, intercepting, misappropriating enforcement funds or property, and delaying the distribution of enforcement case funds.

7. Give full play to the role of lawyers in preventing and cracking down on acts of evading enforcement. The agent lawyer of the person subject to enforcement shall explain to the party the consequences of failing to perform legal obligations, guide and assist them to respect effective legal documents and perform their obligations in accordance with the law. If the person subject to enforcement has illegal circumstances such as breach of trust, the agent lawyer of the enforcement applicant may assist the enforcement applicant in applying to the people's court in accordance with the law for measures such as restricting consumption and including the person in the list of dishonest persons subject to enforcement. If the person subject to enforcement has the ability to perform but refuses to perform a judgment or ruling, the circumstances are serious, and it is suspected of constituting a crime, the agent lawyer of the enforcement applicant may investigate and collect evidence in accordance with the law, and assist the enforcement applicant in filing a complaint with the public security organ or filing a private prosecution with the people's court in accordance with the law.

People's courts at all levels shall increase efforts to prevent and crack down on acts of evading enforcement, and promptly include persons subject to enforcement who meet the statutory circumstances in the list of dishonest persons subject to enforcement in accordance with the law. For persons subject to enforcement who maliciously evade enforcement and transfer or conceal property, promptly apply compulsory measures such as detention and fines in accordance with the law; for persons suspected of committing crimes of refusing to perform judgments or rulings, illegally disposing of seized, attached, or frozen property, and obstructing official duties, the case shall be transferred to the public security organ for filing and investigation in accordance with the law. If the agent lawyer guides and assists the enforcement applicant in filing a private prosecution, the enforcement department of the people's court shall support and cooperate, and the criminal trial department shall promptly accept and adjudicate.

8. Give full play to the role of lawyers in the procedures of participation in distribution and transfer from enforcement to bankruptcy. If the person subject to enforcement is a citizen or other organization, and the property is insufficient to satisfy all claims, the agent lawyer of other creditors who have already obtained enforcement grounds may assist the creditor in applying to the people's court for participation in distribution. For applications that meet the conditions, the people's court shall promptly accept them. If the person subject to enforcement is an enterprise legal person, and the assets are insufficient to satisfy all debts or are obviously lack of solvency, the people's court shall promptly inquire whether the enforcement applicant and the person subject to enforcement agree to transfer the enforcement case to bankruptcy review. If the enforcement applicant or the person subject to enforcement agrees, the agent lawyer shall actively assist the parties in providing relevant materials to the enforcement department of the people's court. After entering the bankruptcy proceedings, if the debtor meets the conditions for reorganization, the agent lawyer shall actively assist the parties in applying to the people's court for reorganization. If a law firm or lawyer is appointed as the bankruptcy administrator by the people's court, it shall earnestly perform its duties, formulate a feasible reorganization plan, and assist the people's court in carrying out the reorganization work.

People's courts at all levels shall standardize the review work of transferring enforcement cases to bankruptcy, ensuring the orderly connection between enforcement proceedings and bankruptcy proceedings. Actively promote the design of simplified bankruptcy procedures, and quickly adjudicate cases where "there is no property to break."

9. Give full play to the role of lawyers in the procedure of concluding this enforcement procedure. If the people's court intends to conclude the enforcement procedure for a case, it shall inform the enforcement applicant or the agent lawyer of the enforcement situation of the case, the property investigation measures taken, the property status of the person subject to enforcement, the basis for concluding the enforcement procedure, and the legal consequences. The agent lawyer shall, within the scope of the authority entrusted, reflect to the people's court the party's opinions on concluding the enforcement procedure, and at the same time fully and objectively explain to the party the legal basis and consequences of the people's court's conclusion of the enforcement procedure.

The people's court shall record the opinions of the enforcement applicant and the agent lawyer in the case files, strictly prohibit the improper application of concluding the enforcement procedure, and shall not force the enforcement applicant or the agent lawyer to agree to conclude the enforcement procedure in a disguised form. After concluding the enforcement procedure, the people's court shall conduct regular inquiries on the case. If it is found that the person subject to enforcement has executable property, and failure to take immediate enforcement measures may lead to the transfer, concealment, sale, or destruction of the property, the people's court may, upon application or ex officio, immediately take control measures such as seizure, attachment, and freezing.

10. Give full play to the role of lawyers in enforcement relief. In the process of handling enforcement cases, people's courts shall strictly regulate enforcement in accordance with the law, and strictly prohibit "cold, hard, horizontal, pushy" and negative enforcement, delay enforcement, and selective enforcement. If the people's court fails to enforce within six months from the date of receiving the written application for enforcement, the agent lawyer may guide the party to apply to the people's court at the next higher level for enforcement. The people's court at the next higher level shall promptly accept and review, may order the original people's court to enforce within a certain period, or may decide to enforce the case by itself or instruct another people's court to enforce. If a party or an interested person believes that the enforcement act of the people's court violates legal provisions, the agent lawyer may guide the party to raise enforcement objections and reconsideration in accordance with the law, or apply to the people's procuratorate for procuratorial supervision in accordance with the law.

People's courts at all levels shall deeply promote the system of lawyers participating in resolving and representing petitions, strictly implement the relevant provisions of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission's "Opinions on Establishing a System for Lawyers to Participate in Resolving and Representing Cases Involving Lawsuit and Petition Visits (Trial)" and the Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, and Ministry of Justice's "Opinions on Gradually Implementing the System of Lawyers Representing Petitions," deeply promote the system of lawyers representing enforcement petitions, protect the parties' right to file petitions in accordance with the law, and actively resolve enforcement petition cases.

11. Give full play to the role of lawyers in enforcement legal publicity. People's courts, judicial administrative organs, and lawyers associations shall give full play to their own functions, and actively carry out enforcement legal publicity and education to the public. They shall widely publicize the consequences of refusing to perform effective legal documents, enhance the initiative and consciousness of parties in performing effective legal documents, promote the formation of a good atmosphere of "law-abiding and trustworthy is glorious, law-breaking and dishonest is shameful," and enhance the legal awareness and integrity awareness of the whole society. They shall clearly explain the difference between "difficulty in enforcement" and "inability to enforce," help parties fully understand litigation risks and the risk of the person subject to enforcement losing the ability to perform, guide the people to establish legal awareness and risk prevention awareness, and promote the solution of enforcement difficulties from the source.

III. Effectively Strengthen the Guarantee for Lawyers' Participation in Enforcement Work

12. Guarantee the right of parties to entrust lawyers to represent enforcement cases in accordance with the law. People's courts shall, in the notice of acceptance of enforcement cases, inform the parties of the right to entrust lawyers to represent enforcement cases, and list the functions and roles of lawyers. For parties who meet the conditions for legal aid but have not entrusted a lawyer, the people's court shall promptly inform the party of the right to apply for legal aid. If a party applies to the people's court for enforcement of a case involving people's livelihood, such as recovery of alimony, support, maintenance, pensions, or labor remuneration, and meets the conditions for legal aid, the people's court may transfer the application materials to the legal aid institution in accordance with relevant regulations, and the legal aid institution shall increase the intensity of legal aid.

13. Construct a benign interactive relationship between enforcement personnel and lawyers. People's courts shall fully implement the requirements of judicial openness, smooth normal communication and channels for expressing opinions and suggestions, and create a clean, fair, just, open, and transparent judicial environment for lawyers to play their roles. They shall strictly regulate the behavior of enforcement personnel, and eliminate problems such as improper contacts or even illegal transactions between enforcement personnel and lawyers. In the process of handling enforcement cases, enforcement personnel are strictly prohibited from meeting with parties, agents, or petitioners in violation of regulations, or eating, living, or traveling with them; strictly prohibited from "eating, taking, card, wanting" or making parties or lawyers bear expenses that should not be borne by them; strictly prohibited from acting as litigation brokers, improperly inquiring about cases, and leaking work secrets. Actively construct a new type of benign interactive relationship between enforcement personnel and lawyers characterized by mutual respect, equal treatment, mutual support, mutual supervision, and proper interaction.

14. Construct a convenient and efficient litigation service system. People's courts shall, through technical means such as APPs, instant messaging, and WeChat mini-programs, create "micro courts" and "smart courts" to provide intelligent litigation services for parties and agent lawyers. They shall deepen the construction and application of enforcement informatization, create an intensive enforcement disclosure platform, do a good job in connecting the platform with systems such as court enforcement case management, and provide "one-stop" enforcement information disclosure services for parties and lawyers. They shall enhance the exchange and interactivity of the enforcement disclosure network, provide parties and lawyers with more convenient channels to contact judges, and mobilize the enthusiasm of lawyers to participate in, support, and supervise enforcement.

15. Strengthen the supervision and management of lawyers' practice. In participating in enforcement work, lawyers shall abide by the professional ethics of "loyalty, serving the people, rule of law, justice, integrity, and dedication," and consciously practice the basic requirements of abiding by the Constitution and laws, being faithful to the truth, strictly observing practice discipline, and insisting on prudence in words and deeds. Judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations shall strengthen the supervision and management of lawyers' practice in enforcement work, and deal with violations of practice norms and professional ethics in accordance with laws and regulations.

16. Establish and improve communication and coordination mechanisms. People's courts, judicial administrative organs, and lawyers associations shall strengthen communication and exchanges, establish and improve a regular coordination and cooperation working mechanism, regularly or irregularly listen to lawyers' opinions and suggestions on the enforcement work of people's courts, study and solve problems encountered in lawyers' participation in enforcement work, promptly coordinate and handle matters such as infringement of lawyers' right to practice and lawyers' violations of laws and regulations, and continuously promote the formation of a work pattern of departmental linkage, joint management, and division of labor and cooperation, providing more powerful guarantees for deeply promoting lawyers' participation in enforcement work.
